actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.forms_get_form.description: Fetch a form's full structure: title, settings, items with their indices and itemIds, question IDs, and current revisionId.
actions.forms_get_form.props.form_id.des: The ID of the form to fetch. Obtain it from forms_create_form, forms_list_responses, or the New Response trigger.
actions.forms_get_response.description: Fetch one submission by its responseId, including all answers keyed by questionId and submission timestamps.
actions.forms_get_response.props.form_id: The ID of the form the response belongs to. Obtain it from forms_list_responses or the New Response trigger.
actions.forms_get_response.props.respons: The ID of the response to fetch. Obtain it from forms_list_responses or the New Response trigger.
actions.forms_list_responses.description: List submitted responses for a form, with each response's responseId, timestamps, and answers keyed by questionId.
actions.forms_list_responses.props.filte: Optional filter on submission time, e.g. "timestamp > 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" or "timestamp < 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z". Only the timestamp field is supported.
actions.forms_list_responses.props.form_: The ID of the form whose responses to list. Obtain it from forms_create_form, forms_get_form, or the New Response trigger.
actions.forms_list_responses.props.page_: Maximum number of responses to return per page (default 5000).
Token from a previous call's nextPageToken to fetch the next page of responses.
description: Receive form responses from Google Forms
triggers.new_response.description: Triggers when someone submits a response to the form. Can also trigger when a respondent edits their response.
triggers.new_response.props.form_id.desc: The form to watch for new responses.
triggers.new_response.props.include_team: Also include forms stored in shared drives.
triggers.new_response.props.info.descrip: Checks the form every few minutes. With **New responses only**, each response starts the flow once, when it is first sent. With **New and edited responses**, it also starts the flow again every time the respondent edits and resends it (respondents can only edit when **Allow response editing** is on in the form settings). Only responses sent after the flow is published count. Upgrading the piece version in the builder pre-selects **New responses only**; choose **New and edited responses** to keep the old behaviour.
triggers.new_response.props.run_on.descr: Choose whether an edited response starts the flow again.
